title: Health platform: Withings OAuth
description: Implement Withings OAuth credential flow, secure token persistence/refresh, configuration, and authentication diagnostics. Adapt only authorization URL, code exchange, and rotating refresh-token behavior from Open Wearables backend/app/services/providers/withings/oauth.py at commit 802862fa1ac08f165a897cb9adc4f4b312b08e5c; persist token pairs atomically; test interrupted and concurrent refresh without live credentials; retain MIT attribution and provenance.
